style: Style: same flat cartoon children's-book style as image 0, thick dark outlines, soft warm colours, simple shapes, friendly. Square picture. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols anywhere.

images.prompt: A quiet sunny street in an Egyptian city: plain beige Cairo apartment buildings with wooden mashrabiya balconies, two palm trees, a minaret in the distance, potted plants on balconies. No people.

The same girl as in image 0 (long wavy dark-brown hair, yellow headband with a bow, white dress with a blue-and-gold collar) stands on a small apartment balcony with a wooden mashrabiya and waters red and yellow flowers in clay pots with a green watering can. She smiles. Egyptian city buildings behind her.
